evacuation.step1Title: Do not panic — act quickly and calmly
evacuation.step1Detail: Take a slow breath. You have time to act if you start now. Panicking causes mistakes.
step1Tips: Warn your immediate family and neighbours
Do not wait for water to reach your door — leave early
Every minute earlier means safer conditions
evacuation.step2Detail: You have 5 minutes. Take only what you can carry. Everything else can be replaced.
step2Tips: ID cards, Aadhar card, important documents
Medicines — especially for elderly and children
Cash — ATMs may not work during floods
One change of clothes per person
evacuation.step3Title: Turn off electricity at the main switch
evacuation.step3Detail: Electrical shocks from flooded wiring kill more people than the flood itself.
step3Tips: Find your home's main electrical breaker or fuse box
Switch it fully to the OFF position
Do NOT re-enter to do this if water is already inside
Turn off gas supply valve too if accessible
evacuation.step4Detail: Go up — upper floors of a strong building, or higher land. Never go to a basement.
step4Tips: Use stairs only — never an elevator during flooding
Walk on pavements, not roads — manholes may be open underwater
Avoid bridges and underpasses — water flows fastest there
Do not attempt to cross moving water on foot
evacuation.step5Title: Avoid floodwater — never walk through it
evacuation.step5Detail: 15cm of fast-moving water can knock an adult off their feet. 30cm can sweep away a car.
step5Tips: If you must move through water, use a stick to check depth
Floodwater contains sewage, chemicals, and sharp objects
Never drive into flooded roads — turn back immediately
Watch for fallen power lines — water conducts electricity
evacuation.step6Title: Go to the nearest rescue camp
evacuation.step6Detail: Rescue camps have food, water, medicine, and shelter. They are the safest place during a flood.
step6Tips: Check the ResQMatrix Safety Map (Map tab) for the nearest camp
Walk along the highest available route
Stay with your family — do not separate
Carry your ID — you may need to register at the camp
evacuation.step7Detail: If you cannot move, make yourself visible and audible to rescuers.
step7Tips: Press SOS in the ResQMatrix app — rescue teams get your GPS location
Wave a brightly coloured cloth from a window or rooftop
Shout or make noise when you hear rescuers nearby
Stay above water level — do not go to ground floor
Keep your phone on and charged to receive rescue calls
evacuation.step8Title: After rescue — do not return home yet
evacuation.step8Detail: Floodwater causes hidden damage. Do not return until authorities say it is safe.
step8Tips: Floodwater may have weakened foundations — building may collapse
Electrical wiring inside walls may still be live
Water supply may be contaminated — do not use taps
Watch for snakes and insects displaced by the flood
Wait for official clearance from NDRF or local authorities

water.storageTip2Sub: Collect fresh water daily — do not store more than one day

water.storageTip3Sub: Heat speeds up bacterial growth — avoid sunlight

water.emergencyAltTitle: If No Water Points Are Available
water.emergencyAltSub: If ResQMatrix water points are offline, follow these steps to make water safer:
water.boilStep1: Filter water through a clean cloth to remove solids
water.boilStep2: Boil at full rolling boil for at least 1 minute
water.boilStep3: Let it cool in a covered container
water.boilStep4: Do not re-expose to outside air until use
water.altTip1: Water purification tablets — 1 tablet per 1L, wait 30 minutes
water.altTip2: Sealed bottled water from shops — check seal before buying
water.altTip3: Call rescue teams — they carry emergency water supply
water.aboutTitle: About the ResQMatrix Water Purification System
water.aboutDesc: ResQMatrix uses solar-powered floating water purification units (FWPU-X) that convert flood water into safe drinking water using a 5-stage process — sediment filtration, carbon filtration, reverse osmosis membrane, and UV sterilization. No mains power required.
water.safetyTip1: Only drink water from ResQMatrix water points or sealed bottles
water.safetyTip2: Never drink floodwater — it contains bacteria and chemicals
water.safetyTip3: Boil water if ResQMatrix points are unavailable
water.safetyTip4: Use purified water for cooking and baby formula
water.safetyTip5: Store collected water in clean, covered containers
water.footer: Water quality monitored in real-time by ResQMatrix sensor network
